record.bible_text: Now the Philistines<WH06430> gathered together<WH06908><WTH8799> all their armies<WH04264> to Aphek<WH0663>: and the Israelites<WH03478> pitched<WH02583><WTH8802> by a fountain<WH05869> which <FI>is<Fi> in Jezreel<WH03157>.

And the lords<WH05633> of the Philistines<WH06430> passed on<WH05674><WTH8802> by hundreds<WH03967>, and by thousands<WH0505>: but David<WH01732> and his men<WH0582> passed on<WH05674><WTH8802> in the rereward<WH0314> with Achish<WH0397>.

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> the princes<WH08269> of the Philistines<WH06430>, What <FI>do<Fi> these Hebrews<WH05680> <FI>here<Fi> ? And Achish<WH0397> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto the princes<WH08269> of the Philistines<WH06430>, <FI>Is<Fi> not this David<WH01732>, the servant<WH05650> of Saul<WH07586> the king<WH04428> of Israel<WH03478>, which hath been with me these days<WH03117>, or these years<WH08141>, and I have found<WH04672><WTH8804> no fault<WH03972> in him since<WH03117> he fell<WH05307><WTH8800> <FI>unto me<Fi> unto this day<WH03117>?

And the princes<WH08269> of the Philistines<WH06430> were wroth<WH07107><WTH8799> with him; and the princes<WH08269> of the Philistines<WH06430> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Make<WH07725><WH00> this fellow<WH0376> return<WH07725><WTH8685>, that he may go again<WH07725><WTH8799> to his place<WH04725> which thou hast appointed<WH06485><WTH8689> him, and let him not go down<WH03381><WTH8799> with us to battle<WH04421>, lest in the battle<WH04421> he be an adversary<WH07854> to us: for wherewith should he reconcile<WH07521><WTH8691> himself unto his master<WH0113>? <FI>should it<Fi> not <FI>be<Fi> with the heads<WH07218> of these men<WH0582>?

<FI> Is<Fi> not this David<WH01732>, of whom they sang<WH06030><WTH8799> one to another in dances<WH04246>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Saul<WH07586> slew<WH05221><WTH8689> his thousands<WH0505>, and David<WH01732> his ten thousands<WH07233>?<CM>

Then Achish<WH0397> called<WH07121><WTH8799> David<WH01732>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Surely, <FI>as<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>, thou hast been upright<WH03477>, and thy going out<WH03318><WTH8800> and thy coming in<WH0935><WTH8800> with me in the host<WH04264> <FI>is<Fi> good<WH02896> in my sight<WH05869>: for I have not found<WH04672><WTH8804> evil<WH07451> in thee since the day<WH03117> of thy coming<WH0935><WTH8800> unto me unto this day<WH03117>: nevertheless the lords<WH05633> favour<WH02896> thee not<WH05869>. <RF>the lords...: Heb. thou art not good in the eyes of the lords<Rf>

Wherefore now return<WH07725><WTH8798>, and go<WH03212><WTH8798> in peace<WH07965>, that thou displease<WH06213><WTH8799><WH07451><WH05869> not the lords<WH05633> of the Philistines<WH06430>. <RF>displease...: Heb. do not evil in the eyes of the lords<Rf>

And David<WH01732> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Achish<WH0397>, But what have I done<WH06213><WTH8804>? and what hast thou found<WH04672><WTH8804> in thy servant<WH05650> so long as<WH03117> I have been with thee<WH06440> unto this day<WH03117>, that I may not go<WH0935><WTH8799> fight<WH03898><WTH8738> against the enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> of my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428>? <RF>with...: Heb. before thee<Rf>

And Achish<WH0397> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799> to David<WH01732>, I know<WH03045><WTH8804> that thou <FI>art<Fi> good<WH02896> in my sight<WH05869>, as an angel<WH04397> of God<WH0430>: notwithstanding the princes<WH08269> of the Philistines<WH06430> have said<WH0559><WTH8804>, He shall not go up<WH05927><WTH8799> with us to the battle<WH04421>.

Wherefore now rise up early<WH07925><WTH8685> in the morning<WH01242> with thy master's<WH0113> servants<WH05650> that are come<WH0935><WTH8804> with thee: and as soon as ye be up early<WH07925><WTH8689> in the morning<WH01242>, and have light<WH0215><WTH8804>, depart<WH03212><WTH8798>.

So David<WH01732> and his men<WH0582> rose up early<WH07925><WTH8686> to depart<WH03212><WTH8800> in the morning<WH01242>, to return<WH07725><WTH8800> into the land<WH0776> of the Philistines<WH06430>. And the Philistines<WH06430> went up<WH05927><WTH8804> to Jezreel<WH03157>.<CM>
